A clear glass filled with water is positioned prominently in the foreground, with ice cubes floating at the top. To the right of the glass, an electronic digital clock displays the time, which progresses from 2:51 to 2:58. The clock's digits are large and white against a black background, making them easily readable. The camera angle is steady, providing a clear view of both objects without any noticeable movement or change in perspective.

caption: The video captures a clear drinking glass filled with water and ice cubes resting on a light floral-patterned tablecloth, to the left of a dark rectangular digital timer whose LCD shows three digits. A wooden surface edge appears at the top right of the frame. Inside the glass, a small dark object sits among the ice and water, shifting its position slightly over the segment. The timer's value increments by one roughly every 0.6 seconds, climbing from 251 through 252, 253, 254, 255, 256, and 257 to 258. Throughout the clip, the glass, ice, clock, tablecloth pattern, and wooden edge stay in essentially the same screen positions. The camera is nearly static, with only minor jitter, so the scene shows no translation or zoom of the objects. The count is already running at the first frame and still running at the last, with no visible indication of its start or end. The object's small drift and the steadily rising digits are the only changes visible within this cropped window.
